name: getKeyPairFromKeystore
description: Loads a key pair from a Java keystore (JKS or PKCS12) and returns a `java.security.KeyPair`. Call `getPrivate()` or `getPublic()` on the result to pass a key to the JWT functions.

params.name: config
params.description: A struct with these keys: `keystore` (absolute path to the keystore file), `keystorePassword`, `keypairPassword` and `keystoreAlias`.

coldfusion.notes: No Adobe reference page exists. The config keys come from the examples on Adobe's createSignedJWT and verifySignedJWT pages and were confirmed on CF2021 and CF2025.

examples.title: Get a key pair from a keystore
